name: clips/t7_tilt
prompt: Continue this exact first-person POV shot. You have just stopped walking and stand completely still in the rain on the flooded concrete promenade. The camera tilts down very slowly and smoothly, like a person lowering their gaze, from the harbour lights to the wet ground just in front, and then your own white sneakers and the ends of your dark jeans come gradually into view from the bottom edge of the frame. The feet stand still, already ankle-deep in the dark water; they never move, never lift, never jump, no splash. Only raindrops make small ripples around them. Hold on the feet. Realistic, cinematic 35mm, no text.
